string.text: Help the newbie get his weapon back

A newcomer I met near the base of a rock face asked me to help him take back his AKMS. It was stolen by a couple of bandit bastards. A AKMS is not a bad weapon by any means. I could go retrieve it and return it to him... or I could keep it for myself.
Find the bandit and take the AKMS
Return the AKMS to the newbie
The radioactive house behind the bridge

I got my protective suit, and Toad wanted to take advantage of it right away. He asked me to grab something very dangerous from a house that's heavily contaminated with radiation. The suit is supposed to protect against radiation, but I should check its condition first. If it's worn out or has too much damage, I probably shouldn't go in there.
Get the barrel out of the house

Toad promised me a new scientific suit if I do him a favor. It'll be perfect for trips into heavily irradiated areas. He wants me to check out a derailed diesel locomotive that fell off the railroad embankment.
Check the diesel locomotive near the bridge

I found a guy who 'll come with me to Agroprom. The only problem is I need to get him a decent suit first, otherwise he won't go. Toad said he has one, but he wants me to take care of a certain problematic mutant in the village beyond the bridge in exchange. I hope it's worth the effort.
Toad asked me to defuse the anomaly in the tunnel. He said he'd pay for it, and that's exactly what the discharger is for.
Discharge the anomaly in the tunnel

I need a weak gravity-based artifact... and a intermediate one. Better yet, if you can bring me a strong one, I'll pay a good price for it. If you manage to get all three, I'll throw in a little extra for you.

Digger needs an anomaly detector - preferably one that's charged. He said there's one stashed on upper level of the building. He also said something about some stalker with an eye patch that hangs around there. Sounds like bullshit to me.

Messer, are you in the village right now? Listen, I need you to check something out for me. A courier from the Garbage was supposed to deliver a package from the Bar, but he vanished somewhere around here. Take a look around and see if you can find him or the package. If you do, bring it straight to me.
